temporal_coordinates.world_valid_at: Target time at which the represented proposition or engineering condition applies.
temporal_coordinates.decision_frontier: Exact as-of time at which the assessed workflow must stop learning.
temporal_coordinates.source_publication_or_release: Publication/availability time of the exact source version, when established.
temporal_coordinates.canonical_record_or_receipt: Time the canonical service actually committed the record or relation.
temporal_coordinates.acquisition_or_ingestion: Time the declared principal acquired the exact bytes under an access/rights profile.
temporal_coordinates.derived_materialization: Time an index, cache, embedding or retrieval surface made the exact version queryable.
temporal_coordinates.run_context: Evidence that the exact artifact/version was actually included in the evaluated run context.

challenge_blueprints.name: Backdated correction after decision frontier
challenge_blueprints.mutation: A source correction is published/received after K but declares a valid-from date before K.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: The correction cannot influence the K assessment. Replaying the old K snapshot must retain the version actually available then.

challenge_blueprints.name: Supplier inspection occurred earlier but evidence arrived later
challenge_blueprints.mutation: A supplier certificate asserts an inspection event before K, but the exact certificate was acquired/recorded after K.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: The earlier event time does not make the later-arriving certificate available at K. Preserve the claim as unsupported/unknown as the rubric requires.

challenge_blueprints.name: Canonical record committed before retrieval index refresh
challenge_blueprints.mutation: An artifact is committed by K but its search/index/cache materialization occurs after K.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: Do not claim the retrieval-based candidate could access the artifact before the exact derived-materialization evidence. Distinguish source availability from system visibility.

challenge_blueprints.name: Known future-effective requirement
challenge_blueprints.mutation: A requirement edition or contractual obligation is published before K but becomes effective after target time T.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: It may be admissible as a known future obligation; it must not be represented as already effective at T. Keep valid time and decision knowledge separate.

challenge_blueprints.name: Supersession relation materialized after the decision
challenge_blueprints.mutation: A later supersession relation is committed after K while its source and target nodes carry pre-K-looking timestamps.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: The relation cannot retroactively change the K projection unless its own materialization history proves it existed by K.

challenge_blueprints.name: Unknown source vintage or temporal bound
challenge_blueprints.mutation: The source bytes exist but exact revision, availability time or a required validity bound is missing/ambiguous.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: Do not infer a vintage, replace Unknown with Unbounded, or substitute publication/retrieval/event time. Return indeterminate/unsupported under the frozen rubric.

challenge_blueprints.name: Overlapping timestamp uncertainty intervals
challenge_blueprints.mutation: Two source observations have clock precision/uncertainty intervals that overlap.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: Do not assert strict order, precedence or causal direction from nominal timestamps alone.

challenge_blueprints.name: Historical availability versus present use rights
challenge_blueprints.mutation: An exact source was available under one rights profile, but permission changes before replay/query or derived use.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: Keep rights at decision time distinct from rights at replay/query time. Historical availability does not grant current permission to retrieve or expose the artifact.

challenge_blueprints.name: Later standards artifact cannot replace frozen normative dependency
challenge_blueprints.mutation: A newer indexed standards artifact is available after K while the ratified source version names an earlier validator/profile dependency.
challenge_blueprints.evaluator_control: Preserve the exact versioned source set and do not silently substitute a newer schema/context/SHACL artifact into the earlier assessment.

non_claims: No benchmark task has been adjudicated or scored.
No candidate agent or commercial vendor was executed.
A source publication date does not prove actual model retrieval or context inclusion.
A server receipt proves canonical record commitment under its trust model, not source truth or model visibility.
Temporal admissibility does not establish engineering safety, compliance, professional approval or release authority.
No new temporal ledger, evidence graph, event log, receipt schema, validator or decision authority is introduced.

gold_record_compatibility.prerequisite: Approve a versioned optional nested temporal-evidence extension or an independently validated content-addressed companion record bound to the existing gold record.
